section: Iterate — change: Swiss Post APIM lookup via Bunny edge service, Supabase removed
title: Address lookup as a Bunny edge script calling Swiss Post APIM
context: Swiss Post shuts down autocomplete4 by 2027-09-30; hosting moves from Netlify+Supabase to Bunny (step 2 of 3). The Post OAuth secret must stay server side; the budget is under EUR 2/month.
decision: One runtime-agnostic handler (edge/address-lookup) runs as a standalone Bunny Edge Script and as Vite dev middleware; Netlify forwards /api/address to it until step 3. Exact origin rules, total per-instance cap per minute, 3 s/8 s deadlines, one 401 retry, no address logging. Localities more than 90 % outside Zug are not offered. Supabase is removed.
consequences: Rate limiting is best effort per instance until Bunny Shield in step 3. One Bunny script serves production and previews; deploys are live at once (guarded script). Rollback is republishing a Bunny release. Supabase must be retired manually (triage card).
rationale: Standalone script works behind the current Netlify site and attaches to the step-3 pull zone unchanged; reviewers (internal, GLM, GPT) approved option A.
rejected: Pull-zone middleware now (site not on Bunny yet); browser calling Post (secret would ship); per-visitor limit via Netlify signed proxy (extra secret, discarded in step 3); 50 % rule (would drop Sihlbrugg).
